title: can’t wait to transition from a come from away to be a newfoundlander...
transcript: I'm flying to Gander, Newfoundland, to see Come From Away, and this is literally the theater trip of my dreams. But let's go back to how we even got here. I saw Come From Away on Broadway in 2017 and I fell in love with it. And a few months ago, I got to see an amazing production of it in New Jersey, where after the show, I met a very cool, very nice Canadian producer who asked if I'd ever been to Gander. I said, no, and he said, you have to go. And I said, that would be a dream. And I didn't know. But that was the start of a moment, one that would lead me to literally come from away to Gander. But first I had to wave goodbye to my dog and head to the the airport, stop by the Chase Lounge, obviously, and find Ben. There are not many flights to Gander, so we're actually stopping in Toronto first for the night. And I was really excited about that cause the real ones know I used to live there anyway. I really don't think that it's hit me yet that it's actually happening, that in less than 24 hours, we will be in Gander, and we're gonna get a few days to just explore before we even see the musical. Side note, did you know that American Airlines has the prettiest planes? I'm sorry, I had to, but I always forget that the flight to Toronto is so fast, it basically had a ginger ale, and then we were seeing the city. I love the Toronto skyline so much. But, yes, we made it into Canada and through our first day of the journey. We're here literally 10 hours until we head to the northeast tip of North America tomorrow. What am I most excited about? I don't know. All of it. To see this beautiful musical and the town that inspired it, but also to see the Dover Fault and the airport and meet the Newfoundlanders. If I get screwed soon, does that mean I really am an Islander? I can't wait to be welcomed to the rock.
classificationReason: Travel vlog en route to Gander, Newfoundland to see Come From Away; the show is not on the provided list and the creator has not yet attended the production in the transcript.
